Becoming.Contacts.Alike.refl.reason: Reflexivity of agreement on the contacts (every signal agrees with itself), a one-line lemma with no reading on the base.

Becoming.Copying.scan_le.reason: The same law for the fold scanSites as Becoming.Courses.inspection_course_le states for every course of the inspection process; Courses proves it without scan_le.

Becoming.CrossSituational.Repeated.not_r.reason: Candidates [0, 0] of the repeated repertoire on the empty record; an empty list of records does not read naturally as a run.

Becoming.CrossSituational.Repeated.separ.reason: The separation conditions for 0 on the empty record of the repeated repertoire, the companion of Repeated.not_resolved; no natural run reading.

Becoming.CrossSituational.narrows.reason: Becoming.Courses.run_narrows states it of the records of every run (proved through candidates_append rather than narrows).

Becoming.CrossSituational.reads_every_if.reason: Becoming.Courses.course_resolves_every_iff states it of every course of words (proved through Segmentation.reads_every_iff rather than this theorem).

Becoming.EitherThroughout.of_em.reason: Excluded middle gives EitherThroughout; its frame form under excluded middle is already on the base, stronger, as Becoming.alike_iff_sameBranchingTests_of_em (no listed moves or claims needed).

Becoming.NowhereDecided.of_em.reason: Excluded middle gives NowhereDecided; a statement about principles of reasoning only (the frame form of NowhereDecided is ListedOutcomeFrames.alike_iff_sameBranchingTests_of_nowhereDecided).

Becoming.LLPO.decidable.reason: LLPO gives the family form where decisions are Decidable data; the listed-outcome frames are built from Decided families, so it has no frame reading.

Becoming.LLPO.of_lpo.reason: LPO gives LLPO in its standard Boolean form; LLPO alone does not give the family form the frames need, so no frame statement follows.

Becoming.Readout.no_judge_of_merged.reason: Becoming.Courses.no_run_judge_of_merged states it of the dates of every run (proved directly, not through this theorem).

Becoming.Registration.retained_keeps.reason: Equal pairs have equal first components (congrArg Prod.fst); a statement using only the prelude.

Becoming.Revising.old_cannot_select_rebu.reason: a fact about one configuration of the constructed revision process; stated at a run configuration the run plays no role (join removed by the integrator)
